title: Crossing from the Meres into Pennywell is never an explicit action even though a 'flat-bottomed ferry sits chained to a post' is described at both landing tiles - the crossing itself is just ordinary 'go east' movement, with no 'board/ride the ferry' verb ever offered. The promised ferry plays as scenery, not an event.
where: The Far Bank Ferry-Landing / Ferry Cut, the Meres-Pennywell border
